newsitem.title: INDIA: India security forces kill eight Naga guerrillas.
newsitem.headline: India security forces kill eight Naga guerrillas.

text.p: Indian security forces killed at least eight Naga separatist rebels and recovered arms in the northeastern state of Manipur near the Burmese border on Monday, officials said.

Officials in the Indian army's eastern headquarters at Calcutta told Reuters the two-hour clash took place at Kodom village in the Senapati district after rebels from the Maoist National Socialist Council of Nagaland attacked from a makeshift camp.
Security forces were in the area as part of a drive against tribal insurgents.
Three rifles, a machine gun, a grenade launcher and a rocket launcher were recovered from the rebels, the officials said.
